description: This is the HTML documentation page for the PHP class Opencart\Admin\Model\Localisation\Zone, which provides an API interface and method listings for managing geographical zones within the OpenCart Admin system.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Model\Localisation\Zone
classes.description: Represents the Zone model in the Opencart Admin Localisation namespace, extending the base Model class, providing methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving zone data.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Adds a new geographical zone using provided data.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Edits an existing zone identified by zone_id with the given data.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Deletes the zone identified by zone_id.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific zone by zone_id.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of zones, with optional filtering based on input criteria.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Retrieves zones associated with a specific country identified by country_id.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the total number of zones matching optional criteria.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total number of zones for a specific country.
